departmentnumber.desc: identifies a department within an organization

displayname.desc: preferred name of a person to be used when displaying entries

employeenumber.desc: numerically identifies an employee within an organization

employeetype.desc: type of employment for a person

gecos.desc: The GECOS field; the common name

gidnumber.desc:
An integer uniquely identifying a group in an
                administrative domain

homedirectory.desc: The absolute path to the home directory

iphostnumber.desc:
IP address as a dotted decimal, eg. 192.168.1.1,
                omitting leading zeros

ipnetmasknumber.desc:
IP netmask as a dotted decimal, eg. 255.255.255.0,
                omitting leading zeros

ipnetworknumber.desc:
IP network as a dotted decimal, eg. 192.168,





                omitting leading zeros

loginshell.desc: The path to the login shell

macaddress.desc:
MAC address in maximal, colon separated hex
                notation, eg. 00:00:92:90:ee:e2

preferredlanguage.desc: preferred written or spoken language for a person

pwdaccountlockedtime.desc: The time an user account was locked

pwdchangedtime.desc: The time the password was last changed

pwdendtime.desc: The time the password becomes disabled

pwdfailuretime.desc:
The timestamps of the last consecutive authentication
         failures

pwdgraceusetime.desc:
The timestamps of the grace authentication after the
         password has expired

pwdhistory.desc: The history of user s passwords

pwdlastsuccess.desc: The timestamp of the last successful authentication

pwdpolicysubentry.desc: The pwdPolicy subentry in effect for this object

pwdreset.desc: The indication that the password has been reset

pwdstarttime.desc: The time the password becomes enabled

uidnumber.desc:
An integer uniquely identifying a user in an
                administrative domain

userpkcs12.desc: PKCS #12 PFX PDU for exchange of personal identity information

usersmimecertificate.desc: PKCS#7 SignedData used to support S/MIME

ipnetwork.desc:
Abstraction of a network. The distinguished value of
                the cn attribute denotes the network

ipservice.desc:
Abstraction an Internet Protocol service.
                Maps an IP port and protocol (such as tcp or udp)
                to one or more names; the distinguished value of
                the cn attribute denotes the service

oncrpc.desc:
Abstraction of an Open Network Computing (ONC)
               [RFC1057] Remote Procedure Call (RPC) binding.
               This class maps an ONC RPC number to a name.
               The distinguished value of the cn attribute denotes
               the RPC service

posixaccount.desc: Abstraction of an account with POSIX attributes

posixgroup.desc: Abstraction of a group of accounts
